selectionRule: Candidates are hypotheses. Promotion requires Pari route-specific quality, latency, whole-app memory, safety and runtime reliability measurements on the target Mac.

candidates.repoState: Pari tooling currently contains Qwen3.5-4B MLX fallback paths while older probes reference Qwen3-4B; resolve exact packaged production checkpoint before the first run.
questions: What exact checkpoint is actually used by the installed production path?
Does any challenger materially improve the V1 routes over this incumbent?

candidates.mtp: No V1 training. Separate official DSpark draft-model acceleration path exists and may be benchmarked later as a runtime experiment.
candidates.hypothesis: A 2B model may already be sufficient for interactive suggestions because the human chooses and edits the result; if so its latency/RAM advantage is more valuable than a small top-1 paragraph-quality gain from a larger model.
Tests whether a modest increase from 2B materially improves context-sensitive alternatives and sentence rewriting enough to justify additional latency/RAM.
A different model family helps detect Qwen-family prose/ranking habits and provides a clean, officially published GGUF control with a stable local runtime.

candidates.quantization: ternary {-1,0,+1} with FP16 group-wise scaling; 1.76 effective bits/weight
candidates.mtp: Published compact pack should not be assumed to retain the original Qwen3.8 MTP block. Benchmark an existing compatible speculative path only if reproducible; do not train a new head for V1.
candidates.hypothesis: Tests whether aggressive low-bit compression can buy noticeably better sentence/paragraph alternatives at a weight footprint comparable to an ordinary 8B Q4 model.

candidates.runtime: Apple-Silicon-compatible INT4/MLX path only if stable at test time
candidates.hypothesis: Sparse 7.9B-total/1.3B-active design may offer a useful throughput/capacity tradeoff, but it should not delay the four required model classes.

nonModelRoutes.role: zero-generation-cost repair/expansion/compression candidates where rules are reliable

stopRule: Do not add another candidate unless it plausibly changes the quality/latency/memory Pareto frontier or represents a materially different architecture/runtime family.
